records.note: Mean pass@1 across three runs, 66 tasks, mini-swe-agent, 8-hour task limit; provider fallback is included. Published Terminal-Bench scores include provider fallback runs. Counting those as failures yields Opus 5.5 58.08%, Sonnet 5.5 62.63%, and Fable 5.1 50.00%. Effort settings are not fully exposed in the extracted leaderboard.

Dealbreaker-gated weighted partial credit; not a fully-correct-task percentage. The finance table was used directly. Some narrative takeaways on the page lag the current table. Three-run results use LLM grading.

Held-out tasks, internet disabled; every criterion must pass, averaging two judge pass rates. Vals Harvey results differ from Harvey LAB-AA v1.1 cited by Meta, which adds hallucination checks and uses a different judging setup.

Average workflow-test success; a test passes at 90% of substeps. Composer uses Cursor CLI, a separate setup. App-building rows use OpenHands except Composer 2.5, which uses Cursor CLI. Its score measures a different model-plus-harness system. Small score differences have no extracted uncertainty bounds.
